mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_mapper WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mapper_type = 'JPA'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_mapper (revision_id, mapper_type, namespace, statement_id, statement_type, sql_body, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, 'JPA', #{namespace}, #{statementId}, #{statementType}, #{sqlBody}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb) , #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT a.annotation_name AS "annotationName" , a.target_id AS "targetId" , a.attributes_json::text AS "attributesJson" , a.file_id AS "fileId" , a.line_start AS "lineStart" , s.symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" , s.simple_name AS "simpleName" , m.name AS "methodName" FROM analysis_annotation a LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.method_id = a.target_id JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = a.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = CASE WHEN a.target_kind = 'METHOD' THEN m.owner_symbol_id ELSE a.target_id END WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = #{targetKind} AND a.annotation_name IN #{n} ORDER BY a.annotation_id
SELECT from_id AS "fromId", to_id AS "toId" FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type = 'EXTENDS' AND from_kind = 'TYPE' AND to_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relation_id

WITH RECURSIVE repo(symbol_id) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id FROM analysis_reference r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.ref_kind = 'EXTENDS' AND r.from_kind = 'TYPE' AND regexp_replace(r.name, '^.*\.', '') IN #{t} UNION SELECT x.from_id FROM analysis_relation x JOIN repo ON x.to_id = repo.symbol_id WHERE x.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND x.relation_type = 'EXTENDS' ) SELECT s.symbol_id AS "symbolId", s.fqn AS "fqn" FROM repo JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.symbol_id = repo.symbol_id WHERE s.kind = 'INTERFACE' ORDER BY s.fqn
SELECT to_id FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND from_id = #{symbolId} AND relation_type = 'USES_TYPE' AND to_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY line_start, relation_id

SELECT method_id AS "methodId", name AS "name", file_id AS "fileId", line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId} AND NOT is_synthetic AND NOT is_static AND NOT is_constructor ORDER BY line_start, method_id

SELECT mapper_id AS "mapperId" , mapper_type AS "mapperType" , statement_type AS "statementType" , sql_body AS "sqlBody" , file_id AS "fileId" , line_start AS "lineStart" , properties_json->>'methodId' AS "methodId" , (SELECT string_agg(x, ',') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(properties_json->'methods') = 'array' THEN properties_json->'methods' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) x) AS "methods" , properties_json->>'fieldId' AS "fieldId" , properties_json->>'call' AS "call" , properties_json->>'language' AS "language" , properties_json->>'entity' AS "entity" FROM analysis_mapper WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mapper_type IN ('JAVA', 'JPA') AND mapper_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY mapper_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (from_id) from_id AS "methodId", file_id AS "fileId", line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND to_id = #{fieldId} AND relation_type = 'ACCESSES_FIELD' AND from_kind = 'METHOD' ORDER BY from_id, relation_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.mapper_type = 'JAVA') AS "java" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.mapper_type = 'JAVA' AND mp.properties_json->>'dynamic' IS NOT NULL) AS "javaDynamic" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.mapper_type = 'JAVA' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = mp.revision_id AND r.from_id = 'S' || mp.mapper_id AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE'))) AS "javaNoTable" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.mapper_type = 'JPA') AS "jpa" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.mapper_type = 'JPA' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = mp.revision_id AND r.from_id = 'S' || mp.mapper_id AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE'))) AS "jpaNoTable" FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.mapper_type IN ('JAVA', 'JPA')
